status: PREDECLARED before challenge outcomes; research only
start_schedule: Every Monday 00:00 UTC with a full 365-calendar-day follow-up entirely within its partition; no carry-in positions
sizing: Requested initial-stop risk = current CLOSED cash balance times risk%; floor to broker lot step, cap maximum volume, SKIP below minimum; never round up to minimum
cash: Book actual native entry fees and each partial/final exit at its recorded time, linearly resized by admitted initial lots. Risk sizing does not use future profits or final outcome. No compounding of unclosed gains. Retain observed source-end censored entries and genuine partial exits, but omit artificial test-end liquidation; do not require future completion to admit an entry.
success: When cash first reaches target, pause new entries, let already-owned positions exit naturally; success only if flat with cash >=10000. If cash falls below target before flat, resume entries. No artificial liquidation or mark-to-market target.
failure: Latch new-entry halt at cash <=20 (80% initial-capital loss); continue existing positions to their natural closes. This is a RESEARCH failure floor, not a reconstructed broker stopout. No reset, top-up or recovery attempt.
exposure: Retain full original initial-stop risk and initial margin until final exit, including partially closed positions; aggregate risk <=min(2*risk%,60%)*current cash, same-symbol risk <=risk%*current cash. Simultaneous entries ordered lexically by key then native ID, never optimized.
daily_pause: UTC day-start closed-cash anchor; latch no new entries for that day after closed cash loss >=min(2*risk%,30%)*day-start cash. Existing positions retain original exits. Gap/fees can exceed limits.
margin: Gross sum of initial proxy margin, no hedge discount; admit only if total margin <=80% of protected cash after existing+new initial-stop reserves and new negative entry costs. Uses maximum of available current and cached per-price margin ratios (USDJPY fixed50/lot). This is conservative admission bookkeeping, NOT a historical liquidation/HMR model.
stress: Extra one available quote-snapshot spread EACH SIDE times contract size, twice negative recorded swap, twice margin proxy. For an unquoted symbol use cached available quote spread. Native entries/exits unchanged; sensitivity, not measured execution.
universe: All current non-news EAs with real filled initial stops in the matching five-year ledger, plus separately sourced Nasdaq5M DI-OFF alternative. Exclude two no-stop hourly profiles, four fast news EAs with special execution uncertainty, and missing V9 archive. No DI-on/off duplicate in a combo.

search.singles: Every eligible variant times six risk levels
search.shortlist: Eight distinct EA families using their best development configuration; never both Nasdaq DI variants
search.combinations: All pairs and triples from the eight shortlisted configurations' EA variants, each at six common risk levels; plus predeclared existing named baskets using eligible members only
search.selection: Primary: fastest conditional median days among configurations with >=50% development target hits; tie higher hit rate, lower median closed DD, lexical config ID. If none qualify, highest hit rate then lowest mean capped completion days (non-hits=365), higher median ending cash, lexical ID; explicitly NONE QUALIFIED.
search.other_locked_views: Also lock highest-development-hit-rate and fastest-single-observed-hit configuration for each of single/combo; lottery winner is explicitly retrospective, not recommendation
search.evaluation: Write SELECTION.json before opening evaluation outcomes. Evaluate only locked configurations on equal full-horizon evaluation starts, both base and stress. Do not reselect from evaluation.
search.scope: Finite historical search, NOT best possible among all strategies/brokers/guards. These strategy dates were previously researched, not genuinely untouched OOS. Multiple overlapping starts are dependent.

metrics: all-start median days only if >=50% hits
closed trade win rate/PF/streaks on detailed representative path
limitations: 100x capital target is extreme; high risk can lose most or all capital. No guarantee or future probability claim.
Closed-cash replay does not measure floating equity, broker stopout, intrabar liquidation, order latency or actual account execution. A modeled success can be untradeable in reality.
Immutable standalone fills do not recover counterfactual later signals after skipped entries, changed EA state or changed lot size. No native simultaneous portfolio test.
Historical source Trial16 and current demo Trial15 are different feeds; mixed/generated ticks, linear resizing and sampled costs do not reproduce real liquidity/slippage.
Full original stop reserve until final partial exit is deliberately conservative, not exact EA risk release.
Same-second exit ordering may use publisher 1ms epsilon for sorting, not measured latency. Close-first cross-position tie convention may not be executable.
No live changes, trades, installers, BAT edits or automatic push.
